source: The owner's Coach Mode spec, coach/SPEC.md section 4 (CD-004). The stops are the order the owner runs a first series of client sessions in; the questions are the owner's own plain words for each stop.
confidenceNote: A coaching convention, not a sourced figure: no number in this file is money or a rate. Edit it without code; coach/engines/session.js evaluates each stop's doneWhen from the household, never from a typed answer.
note: stops holds every stop once; a path is an ordered list of stop ids. Each stop: fields (ids in data/fields.json, one entry box each; 'list:debt', 'list:asset', 'list:goal' is the whole list), figures (read-outs the stop shows, ids in readouts), questions (each one item), doneWhen (tests coach/engines/session.js knows, all must pass), doneLabel (what done means, in words). rail is always shown.

life.title: The life picture
life.covers: What they want, when, values, big dates coming (wedding, move, kid, career change).

questions.text: If money worked out, what would the next ten years look like?
What big dates are coming: a wedding, a move, a kid, a career change?
What do you spend on that you never regret?

life.doneLabel: At least three goals with rough dates

income.title: Income
income.covers: Every source, take-home, pay frequency, variability.

questions.text: Every way money comes in, even small or irregular?
What lands in your account each payday?
How much does a good month differ from a bad one?

income.doneLabel: Take-home monthly is known, or known roughly

spending.title: Spending and cash flow
spending.covers: Needs (food, housing, transport), wants, the typical month, surplus.

questions.text: Walk me through a typical month: rent, food, getting around.
Where does money go that you wish it did not?

debt.title: Debt
debt.covers: Every debt, rate, minimum, payoff order.

questions.text: Every debt: cards, car, student loans, anything owed to family?
Which one keeps you up at night? That can go first even if it is not the dearest.

debt.doneLabel: Payoff plan chosen, debt-free date shows

safety.title: Safety

questions.text: If income stopped tomorrow, how long could you go?
Who depends on your income, and what insurance do you have through work?

safety.doneLabel: Emergency months computes, gap named in a shared note or homework

assets.title: Assets and accounts
assets.covers: Every account, tax type, contributions, match, fees.

questions.text: Every account with money in it, and roughly what is in each?
Does your employer match, and are you getting all of it?
Do you know the fees on your retirement funds?

assets.doneLabel: Net worth and savings rate compute

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.covers: Filing status, state, pretax vs Roth, easy wins.

questions.text: How did you file last year, and did you get a refund or owe?
Pretax or Roth: do you expect your tax rate to be higher now or later?

taxes.doneLabel: Marginal rate known and one tax move named

goals.title: Goals and the life map
goals.covers: Price each goal, place it, fund it.

questions.text: What would each goal cost, roughly, and by when?
If not everything fits, which goal moves first?

goals.doneLabel: Every goal has a monthly number and a status

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.covers: The big decisions: house, car, job, kid, sabbatical, a move. Each gets a verdict.

questions.text: Which decision is on your mind this year?
Knowing what it costs, is it go, wait, or no?

decisions.doneLabel: Each decision has a verdict: go, wait, or no
